summary: With History scoped to a branch deleted through the app, Refresh opens All history with one explanation instead of reporting the repository unavailable, and a later Push does not report the vanished scope again
limitations: Each launch writes only to its own copy of the recipe build. The polite announcement is the view test's, not the frames'. The window cannot go below the app's 1000 x 680 minimum (main.rs:2095); at that width, with this branch name, the 13 pt explanation fits on one line and the 18 pt one wraps to two. A notice taller than the banner's bounded height would scroll inside it; no frame shows one. Worktree scopes, macOS, native Wayland and fractional scale factors are not covered natively

fixture.name: history-vanished-scope-refresh
fixture.description: three commits on main; feature/refresh-explains-a-vanished-branch at the second, which main contains, so a safe delete accepts it; a local bare origin holding main at the second commit, which main tracks, so main is one commit ahead and a later Push writes without adding an upstream
